How We Work Together

A clear path from first conversation to launch.

You always know what is being decided, what comes next and what I need from you. I keep the process focused and involve you at the points where your input matters.

  1. 01

    Discovery & Alignment

    We begin with a focused conversation about your business, audience, requirements and what the project needs to accomplish. I identify priorities, dependencies and important constraints early so we start from a shared understanding.

  2. 02

    Scope & Technical Direction

    Together, we confirm deliverables, responsibilities, milestones and project boundaries. I define the technical direction and clarify the content, assets and access needed before development begins.

  3. 03

    Design, Development & Reviews

    I turn the agreed direction into working interfaces and functionality, making UX/UI and implementation decisions in context. You review progress at planned checkpoints-often through a preview or staging environment-so feedback stays timely and revisions remain focused.

  4. 04

    QA, Launch & Handoff

    Before launch, I test responsive behavior, functionality and the final technical setup across relevant devices and scenarios. I then handle or support deployment and provide the agreed handoff, documentation or training needed to manage the finished product.

Optional ongoing support and improvements are available after launch.

Why Work With Me

Thoughtful decisions, precise execution and clear ownership.

I stay close to both the business goal and the implementation-asking the right questions early, identifying UX and technical risks, and carrying each decision through to a launch-ready result.

  1. 01

    Precision beyond the visual

    Visual accuracy is only one part of a refined result. I pay equal attention to content hierarchy, interaction states, responsive behavior and the small inconsistencies that shape how a product feels to use.

  2. 02

    Technical depth beyond the interface

    I work beyond basic theme configuration and visual implementation, considering structure, data, integrations and maintainability so the finished product remains practical to manage and extend.

  3. 03

    One clear point of ownership

    From understanding requirements and planning the approach to development, QA and launch, I remain directly involved. Communication stays clear, decisions keep their context and fewer details are lost between handoffs.

  4. 04

    Quality built into development

    Performance, technical SEO and accessibility are considered while the product is being built-not added as a final checklist once the main work is complete.

I have been running a website with a booking system for parking rentals for years. Unfortunately, working with different web designers and developers was often very difficult. I frequently heard, "That can’t be done," or there were repeated attempts to sell me something new.

That changed when I found Kristina.

When my website was eventually hacked, the developers I had worked with before wanted to build an entirely new website because finding the cause of the problem and identifying exactly where the site had been compromised was too much effort for them.

Kristina approached it completely differently. She got straight to work and solved the problem in a very short time.

Since then, Kristina has completely reworked my website and optimized the booking system. This has made it much easier for me to manage the large number of bookings and create invoices.

I can recommend Kristina without hesitation, whether for a small business or a larger company. She finds the right solution for each situation and does not simply give up when something looks difficult at first.

I am genuinely very happy to have finally found someone I can rely on and know that when a problem comes up, Kristina will find a solution.
